# Fix: profile image not showing on About page

## Context

On the About page (`/about`), the profile photo in the hero is not rendering for the user. The expected behavior is that `/assets/branding/profile.jpg` displays inside the circular/rounded frame next to the intro text. The user reports "don't show image, it should show my image."

What I verified during exploration:
- File exists at `public/assets/branding/profile.jpg` (1.56 MB, JPEG 2822×3447, valid).
- Code references the correct path at `src/app/about/page.tsx:119`.
- No Next.js image config restrictions in `next.config.ts`.
- No CSS in `globals.css` hides the image.

Most likely failure mode given the symptom: Next.js's built-in image optimizer occasionally fails (silently in browser, error in terminal) on very large source images (this one is 2822×3447 / 1.56 MB) when rendered with `fill` in dev mode. The `motion.div` wrapper also starts at `opacity: 0`; if Framer Motion fails to mount for any reason, the image stays invisible.

## Approach

Make the profile photo display robustly by:

1. Switching from `fill` to explicit `width`/`height` on the `<Image>` so layout doesn't depend on the parent's measured size at mount.
2. Removing the `opacity: 0` initial animation gate from the photo — the image will fade in via a CSS-only transition once loaded, so it's never invisible if Framer Motion stalls.
3. Keeping `priority` so the LCP image preloads, and adding `quality={85}` to keep optimizer output reasonable for the large source.

If after step 1–3 the photo still doesn't render in the browser, fall back to a plain `<img>` tag (bypasses the optimizer entirely) — diagnosed in step 4 below.

## Files to change

- `src/app/about/page.tsx` (lines ~108–130) — the profile photo block inside the Hero Section.

## Concrete edit

Replace the current profile photo block (`src/app/about/page.tsx:108-130`):

\```tsx
<motion.div
    initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 }}
    animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
    transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.25, 0.4, 0.25, 1] }}
    className="shrink-0"
>
    <div className="relative">
        <div className="absolute -inset-1.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--accent)] via-[var(--accent-hover)] to-[var(--accent)] opacity-20 blur-md" />
        <div className="relative w-[140px] h-[140px] md:w-[170px] md:h-[170px] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-[var(--accent)]/20">
            <Image
                src="/assets/branding/profile.jpg"
                alt="Nabi Rahmani - Flutter Developer"
                fill
                className="object-cover"
                sizes="170px"
                priority
            />
        </div>
        <div className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 border-[3px] border-[var(--bg-primary)]" />
    </div>
</motion.div>
\```

With:

\```tsx
<motion.div
    initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
    animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
    transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.25, 0.4, 0.25, 1] }}
    className="shrink-0"
>
    <div className="relative w-[140px] h-[140px] md:w-[170px] md:h-[170px]">
        <div className="absolute -inset-1.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--accent)] via-[var(--accent-hover)] to-[var(--accent)] opacity-20 blur-md" />
        <div className="relative w-full h-full rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-[var(--accent)]/20 bg-[var(--bg-secondary)]">
            <Image
                src="/assets/branding/profile.jpg"
                alt="Nabi Rahmani - Flutter Developer"
                width={340}
                height={340}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                priority
                quality={85}
            />
        </div>
        <div className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 border-[3px] border-[var(--bg-primary)]" />
    </div>
</motion.div>
\```

Why this is safer:
- Explicit `width`/`height` removes dependency on parent measurement that `fill` requires.
- Outer wrapper now has fixed dimensions, so the rounded frame never collapses to 0×0.
- Background placeholder (`bg-[var(--bg-secondary)]`) makes any rendering issue visible immediately as a colored box instead of nothing.
- Smaller initial scale (0.95 instead of 0.8) keeps it nearly visible even before animation runs.

## Verification

1. Run `npm run dev` and open `http://localhost:3000/about`.
2. Confirm the profile photo appears next to the heading "I build apps people actually use".
3. Check the terminal for any Next.js image optimizer errors (e.g., `sharp` warnings on the 2822×3447 source).
4. **Fallback if still broken:** swap `<Image …/>` for a plain `<img src="/assets/branding/profile.jpg" alt="Nabi Rahmani - Flutter Developer" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />` to bypass `next/image` entirely and confirm whether the optimizer is the culprit. If that works, the long-term fix is to downsize the source JPEG to ~800×800 with `sips -Z 800 public/assets/branding/profile.jpg` (or re-export from the original) so `next/image` handles it cleanly.
5. Test light/dark mode toggle to ensure the border and ring still look right.
